title: One Service Contract per Rental Property
content:
**Rule.** A rental property carries only one Rental Property Service Contracts contract at a time.

1. A new rental property service contract is not enrolled when a rental property service contract for the same property address is in status waiting period, active or suspended for nonpayment.
2. Rental coverage and homeowner coverage are mutually exclusive for the same property: a new rental property service contract is not enrolled when a Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts contract for the same property address is in status waiting period, active or suspended for nonpayment.
3. An owner who moves out and starts renting the home cancels the homeowner service contract and enrolls a rental property service contract; an owner who moves into a former rental does the reverse.
4. A purchaser who will occupy the property cannot take a transfer and buys a homeowner service contract instead.

**Evidence.** Items 1 and 2 are read from the system records before the enrollment: the property address and status of the rental property service contracts and of the homeowner service contracts on file. The contracts are matched to the new enrollment by the same property address.

## Status of an existing contract on the same address

| Existing contract on the same property address | Its status | New rental property service contract |
|---|---|---|
| Rental property service contract | waiting period | not enrolled |
| Rental property service contract | active | not enrolled |
| Rental property service contract | suspended for nonpayment | not enrolled |
| Homeowner service contract | waiting period | not enrolled |
| Homeowner service contract | active | not enrolled |
| Homeowner service contract | suspended for nonpayment | not enrolled |

*Hypothetical cases.* A rental contract on 14 Elm Street that shows cancelled does not stand in the way of a new rental contract on 14 Elm Street under items 1 and 2. A homeowner service contract on 14 Elm Street that shows active does.
